## Stage 3: source-round-tripping designer

C# object initializer editing now adds and removes typed literal properties, creates an initializer on `new Control()`, handles signed numbers and character/string escapes, and preserves comments/trivia and line endings using compiler token spans. The editor refuses expression-based values, identity mutations, unsupported property types and stale transactions. These constructor changes remain restart-required: source editing support is not constructor state migration.

The primary Develop panel exposes **Set binding/resource**, **Remove property**, and **Move into** a named host. Literal edits still protect bindings; the explicit expression action parses and validates supported markup. XAML moves preserve the existing element bytes, reject cycles, nonempty content slots, namespace-resolution changes and template-scope moves, and are one undoable transaction.

Regression paths: `tests/designer-roundtrip.test.js` (12 cases) plus three browser gates. Local verification: 247 Node tests and 20 development-browser tests. General imperative C# UI reconstruction, custom typed expressions and arbitrary AST refactorings remain outside these operations.

def test_csharp_designer_adds_and_removes_initializer_properties(self):
        self.page.check('#dev-hot');self.page.locator('#dev-tree button').filter(has_text='#CodeButton').click()
        self.page.fill('#dev-property-name','Height');self.page.fill('#dev-property-value','72');self.page.click('#dev-set-property')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Restart required',timeout=30000)
        self.assertIn('Height = 72',self.source('MainView.axaml.cs'))
        self.page.click('#dev-restart')
        expect(self.preview.get_by_role('button',name='Built in C#',exact=True)).to_have_css('height','72px',timeout=30000)
        self.page.locator('#dev-tree button').filter(has_text='#CodeButton').click()
        self.page.fill('#dev-property-name','Height');self.page.click('#dev-clear-property')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Restart required',timeout=30000)
        self.assertNotIn('Height = 72',self.source('MainView.axaml.cs'))
        self.page.click('#dev-restart')
        self.preview.get_by_role('button',name='Built in C#',exact=True).click()
        expect(self.preview.get_by_text('Count: 1',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
        self.assertEqual(self.errors,[])
    def test_explicit_binding_designer_updates_preview_and_can_remove_binding(self):
        self.page.check('#dev-hot');self.page.locator('#dev-tree button').filter(has_text='#CounterLabel').click()
        self.page.fill('#dev-property-name','Text');self.page.fill('#dev-property-value','{Binding Text, ElementName=Input}');self.page.click('#dev-set-expression')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 1',timeout=30000)
        self.preview.get_by_role('textbox').fill('designer binding')
        expect(self.preview.get_by_text('designer binding',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
        self.page.locator('#dev-tree button').filter(has_text='#CounterLabel').click()
        self.page.fill('#dev-property-name','Text');self.page.click('#dev-clear-property')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 2',timeout=30000)
        self.assertEqual(self.page.frames[-1].evaluate('appHandle.root.CounterLabel.Text'),'')
        self.assertEqual(self.errors,[])
    def test_source_designer_moves_selected_control_between_named_hosts(self):
        text=self.source('MainView.axaml').replace('  </StackPanel>','    <Border Name="Destination" />\n  </StackPanel>')
        self.page.locator('#editor').fill(text);self.page.click('#dev-restart')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-tree')).to_contain_text('#Destination',timeout=30000)
        frame=self.page.frames[-1];identity=frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Input.uid')
        self.page.check('#dev-hot');self.preview.get_by_role('textbox').fill('move with designer')
        self.page.locator('#dev-tree button').filter(has_text='#Input').click()
        self.page.fill('#dev-destination','Destination');self.page.click('#dev-reparent')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 1',timeout=30000)
        self.assertEqual(frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Destination.Content.uid'),identity)
        expect(self.preview.get_by_role('textbox')).to_have_value('move with designer')
        self.page.get_by_role('button',name='Undo design',exact=True).click()
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 2',timeout=30000)
        self.assertTrue(frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Input.parent===appHandle.root.Panel'))
        self.assertEqual(self.errors,[])
